accounting.buyFill: Frozen effective Entry price includes inherited buy-side semantics
accounting.cashRelease: R34 confirmed sell proceeds minus cost at exact exit fill time
accounting.daily: only consecutive certified EOD endpoints; first certified EOD against initial equity only if no prior invalid EOD; full 24-session aggregate null if any session invalid
accounting.equity: null when any owned position lacks valid as-of mark; final equity/portfolio return null unless every scheduled EOD certified, end flat and contiguous
accounting.geometric: (final/1000000)**(1/N)-1 only for full contiguous N scheduled sessions
accounting.mark: V1 same-session same-segment last completed owned close or Entry OPEN, auction at 15:30; no future/interpolation/zero-fill
accounting.overnight: unresolved lock; fail-closed if R34 cannot enter next session while positions open

comparability: Same frozen Entry, initial cash, MAX3, 100-share sizing, cost, session window, R50 source as applicable; terminal control uses same saved v3-B predictions.
eligibility: ONE_SHOT_AT_FROZEN_ENTRY_TIMESTAMP; no retroactive/revisited Entry, no extra eligibility extension

evaluator.boundaries: half-open at lower boundary inclusive, upper exclusive; <0 strictly negative; >=10 includes 10; 0 included in 0–1
metrics: partial valuation and valid EOD returns
evaluator.primary: Frozen Entry effective price -> strictly later same-session best observed High; unknown/censored kept distinct

eventOrdering: at each union of session start, frozen Entry timestamps, held EXIT fill timestamps, and 15:30
process held confirmed EXIT fills at their exact time, returning net proceeds and freeing symbols/slots
unresolved EXIT never releases cash or slots
mark remaining holdings from same-segment as-of owned observations only
collect only frozen one-shot Entries at the exact timestamp
rank same-timestamp eligible Entries by frozen CI Capital v3-B score
size with inherited R37 1/3 current equity target, available cash and 100-share floor, in that order
record exclusive reject reasons and post-batch state

recycling.definition: same-arm v3-B R50-A funded Entry IDs absent from same-arm v3-B terminal-hold funded IDs
recycling.earlyCashMinutes: terminal reference minute 930 minus saved confirmed R50-A model exit fill minute, session wall minutes
recycling.opportunityCost: for jointly funded Entry IDs, compare same-quantity exit price PnL R50-A vs terminal; post-exit remaining observed High evaluator-only, no assumed executable peak
recycling.releaseWitness: for each incremental fund report prior confirmed R50-A exits with timestamp, net released cash, freed slot; shared witnesses not double counted as extra entries

sameSymbol: Inherit R34: only one concurrent position per symbol; later frozen event can fund after prior confirmed EXIT only if a distinct frozen entry exists.
scope: EXPERIMENTAL DEVELOPMENT INTEGRATED REPLAY; no formal Capital or Final EXIT selection
